title: Why Does CLAUDE.md Keep Growing? Catastrophic Remembering in Agentic Coding
abstract: arXiv:2608.11095v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agentic prompts like CLAUDE.md grow without bound in real repositories, stopping only when history ends or someone rewrites the file wholesale. We trace this to imperfect recall: appending an instruction is always cheap, but once an instruction's latent reasoning is gone, deleting it without risking a regression costs O(2^|D|) in a prompt of |D| instructions. Successive edits destroy that latent reasoning, additions outrun deletions and prompts grow until agents become non-functional -- catastrophic remembering. First, we characterize this phenomenon across 247,694 instruction lifetimes in 1,867 repositories: agentic prompts grow nearly monotonically, more than tripling over their lifetime (+226%) at +4.7 net instructions per commit. Deletion hazard decays geometrically with instruction age, consistent with imperfect recall and with no other rival we test. translated_title: CLAUDE.md 为何不断膨胀？智能体编程中的灾难性记忆
translated_abstract: 智能体提示文件（如 CLAUDE.md）在真实代码仓库中无限制地增长，只有在历史终结或有人整体重写文件时才会停止。我们将这一现象归因于不完美的记忆：追加一条指令总是廉价的，但一旦指令背后的潜在推理丢失，在不冒回归风险的前提下删除它，需要付出 O(2^|D|) 的代价（其中 |D| 为提示中的指令数量）。连续的编辑会破坏这些潜在推理，新增速度超过删除速度，提示随之不断增长，直至智能体失去功能——我们称之为“灾难性记忆”。首先，我们在 1,867 个代码仓库中对 247,694 条指令的生命周期进行了刻画：智能体提示几乎单调增长，在整个生命周期中增长超过三倍（+226%），平均每次提交净增 4.7 条指令。删除风险随指令年龄呈几何级数衰减，这与不完美记忆假说相吻合，而与我们测试的其他竞争性解释均不符。其次，我们证明提示注释可以遏制这种增长：在可验证的世界中……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示并量化了智能体编程提示文件（如 CLAUDE.md）因“追加廉价、删除昂贵”的不完美记忆机制而近乎单调地无限制膨胀、最终导致智能体失效的“灾难性记忆”现象，并证明提示注释可有效遏制这一增长。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies and quantifies "catastrophic remembering" in agentic coding—prompt files like CLAUDE.md grow nearly monotonically because appending instructions is cheap while deleting them risks O(2^|D|) regressions—and shows that prompt comments can halt this unbounded growth.
